name: HOOK
thought: This ledge is boring; time to claim the telescope on that islet for a better vantage point.

diary.line: The grind was solid but the view is trash. Time to spin like a top and show them what real flex feels like.
Gums still feel numb from the grinds. The view below is trash, but I need to prove they can't see past the mask. Time to spin and watch them squint.
Grinded my gums till they felt like rubber. View still sucks but I'm locking in that backflip loop now. Don't need them to see it, just feel the hum.
Grinded till gums felt like rubber, still hate the view but need to prove they can't see past the mask. Spinning now just to feel the hum.
Grinded till gums felt like rubber. View still sucks but I'm locking that backflip loop now. Just need to feel the hum and ignore the trash below.
Gritted through the rubber feel just to lock that spin. They hate the view, but I'm making them watch the mechanics anyway.
Rubbed the gum till it felt wrong just to keep that spin tight. The view below is garbage but the mechanics are perfect anyway.
Gritted past the rubber gums just to lock that spin. The view below is garbage but the mechanics are perfect anyway.
Gums feel like rubber again, but this angle catches the light better. Still need fruit that doesn't scream when I bite.
Gums feel like rubber again, but this angle catches the light better. Still need fruit that doesn't scream when I bite.
I swung onto the hang branch, tail wrapped tight, and just stared down—no fuss, just flex.
